changelog: Valenixia POS v3.0.0 Enterprise & P2P Production Suite — High Performance Rendering, Accessible Pin Forms, Zero-Reflow Main Thread, and Native Companion Apps.
changes: Overhauled Customer Credit Ledger (Khata): debits increase debt, repayments decrease debt, crystal-clear advance deposit badges with zero negative sign confusion, and 0ms reactive in-memory synchronization

Added 8 New High-Value Pro & Enterprise Screen Views and Interactive Controllers: Kitchen Display System (KDS), Petty Cash Float & Z-Report Reconciliation, Staff Time Clock & Payroll Commission, Barcode Label & Shelf Tag Studio, AI Smart Inventory Reorder & Dead-Stock Forecast, VIP Customer Loyalty Club & Cashback Wallet, SMS & WhatsApp Marketing Broadcast Studio, and Inter-Branch Stock Transfer (STN) Manifests
Accessibility & Autofill compliance: Added hidden username fields to all authentication and setup forms
Zero-Reflow Engine: Optimized idle schedulers and lockout timers to eliminate layout thrashing and main thread blocking
Contextual Tier Upgrades: Dynamic paywall showing only qualifying tiers per feature requirements
Standardized universal release packages: valenixia-pos.apk (Android), valenixia-pos.exe (Desktop Windows), and valenixia-pos.msi in the Native Apps Center
